description:
Declare your Decibel trading account once, for all your strategies. No signatures
        and no change to your bot: Pitbi reads public fills and recognises each strategy by the
        rules you declare with update_strategy (markets, fill sizes, UTC hours, order type,
        side). To PROVE the account, place ONCE yourself, with your usual order tool, the proof
        order in the result (limit buy far below the price, unique digits; it never fills),
        cancel it, then call with check=true (max once a minute). new_proof=true if it
        expired. proof_order=true returns that order structured for your order tool
        (market_addr, price_units, size_units, post-only, client_order_id) with a 'safety'
        block of guaranteed limits (buy only, value <= $5, price <= 60% of the mark): verify
        them yourself, if anything differs do NOT place it. No arguments = the status.
        delay_seconds: 0, 3600 or 86400 for all holdings. The address is never shown.
name: link_portfolio
